text:
Marta: Quick context 4 - ACME internal pilot ask: surface per-route tuning hints (batch, cache, quantize) + eval alerts when model quality regresses. They want something lightweight they can opt into for 1-2 critical routes.

Devon: High-level proposal: ship a triage MVP with 3 parts: (1) read-only recommendations surfaced in Console, (2) small sampled telemetry for eval alerts (pilot-only), (3) route opt-out + audit trail. No auto-apply. Can we scope that to 2 sprints?

Kai: Two things to call out: (a) batching hints often require backend batching schema changes to be effective, (b) quantization recs need model artifact metadata. We can fake heuristics for MVP using simple heuristics on token length and concurrency.

Priya: Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- recommendations visible on route page for pilot routes
- user can Preview changes and optionally Apply (Apply = show CLI/config snippet only, not auto-change)
- eval-alert fires within 5m of regression and sends to the pilot's Slack webhook
- metrics: >=20% token-cost save signal for at least one pilot route OR clear rationale documented

Marta: UX note: keep CTAs minimal: [Preview suggestion] [Copy config]. Avoid forcing a modal.

Devon: Minimal config sample for Preview copy:```yaml
# preview only - paste to route config
route_tuning:
  batch_hint: 8 # suggested concurrent grouping
  kv_cache: true
  quant_recommendation: int8-recommended
  recommended_by: tune-v0.1
```

Kai: Ops constraints: need a per-route feature flag, rate-limited telemetry (sample 1%) and a cost-safety check when suggestions would increase tokens > +10% cost. Also request an infra spike to ensure p99 latency stays within +15% for pilot.

Priya: Can we keep eval-alerting scoped to a single eval metric (top-1 response drift) for pilot? That reduces integration work.

Marta: Yes, pilot metric = top-1 semantic drift against golden set. Alert policy: threshold + cooldown (e.g., >0.08 drift sustained for 3 checks).

Devon: Rollout plan idea:
1) Spike (3 days) to validate heuristics and telemetry cost
2) MVP (2 sprints) build + pilot onboarding (ACME)
3) Iterate to add model-aware quant recs and multi-metric evals

Kai: Estimated staffing: spike = 1 eng (3d), MVP = 2 engs + 0.5 infra, UX = 0.5 designer. Ops runbook for alerts + playbook for rollback needed.

deploy-bot: created ticket RW-6120 for spike and RW-6121 for MVP onboarding: https://redwood/internal/RW-6121

Priya: Risk register quick items:
- false positives from eval-alerts -> customer fatigue
- increased cost from ill-advised batch suggestions
- quant recs that break model semantics if auto-applied (hence recommend-only)

Marta: Mitigation: sampled rollout, preview-only UI, explicit opt-in for each route, and an emergency global disable.

Devon: Proposed launch checklist (must-haves):
- UX surface + Preview/Copy workflow implemented
- per-route opt-in flag and audit logs
- eval-alert -> Slack webhook + Console notifications for pilot tenant
- basic docs and onboarding checklist for customer success

Priya: I'll stitch this into a short PRD and assign owners. If everyone agrees, we lock scope to recommend-only quant, sampled telemetry, one eval metric, and route-level opt-in.

Kai: +1. I'll book the spike.

Marta: Thanks all 4 I'll schedule a 30m kickoff with ACME pilot owners tomorrow. :calendar:
